Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

neque

neque (nec)

conjunction, first in its clause; nec mostly before consonants

and not, nor

In this lexicon

  • and not

    the recommended word · classical · Plin. Ep. 1.15.1: prōmittis ad cēnam, nec venīs?; Cic. Fam. 14.3.5: mihi tē cārius nihil esse nec umquam fuisse

  • neque … neque (nec … nec): neither … nor

    classical

Examples

  • heus tū! prōmittis ad cēnam, nec venīs?

    hey, you! you promise to come to dinner and don’t come?Plin. Ep. 1.15.1

    In the entry for and not

  • nesciō quid nunc tacēs nec muttīs

    I don’t know why you are quiet now and don’t say a wordPetr. 61.1

  • nīl spernat auris, nec tamen crēdat statim

    let the ear scorn nothing, and yet not believe at oncePhaedr. 3.10.51

    take care of yourself, and be sure that nothing is dearer to me than you, and never has beenCic. Fam. 14.3.5
